assertion_audit: tests/test_route_before_queue.py:210-213 fails if either ready metered request takes the local backend, route_mode ceases to say picker, or the full local request does not queue on local; the backend expectation comes from _selection, but the local-default countercase makes an ignored pick red.
tests/test_route_before_queue.py:221-224 fails if any local-only request launches or the queue stores fewer than three requests.

tests/test_route_before_queue.py:236-259 fails if the upstream request loses its wait, backend or picker reason, launches under the deliberately local-only ordering, fails to launch after release, or changes backend; it does not fail if its selected model changes to beta's default because _selection and the fixture's beta backend both name requested-model.

tests/test_route_before_queue.py:274-279 fails if fallback does not launch locally, loses the metered source or pace reason, or omits fallback from admit_request; the last equality compares two outputs derived from one fallback map, but the separate constant and literal checks constrain its contents.
tests/test_route_before_queue.py:289-305 fails if a ready picked pace hold fails to fall back, loses fallback route_mode or reason, or queues on the metered backend.

tests/test_route_before_queue.py:317-323 fails if an explicitly named route falls back or loses its hold; lines 341-344 fail if the CLI reports success without a queued metered request and named-route marker.
tests/test_route_before_queue.py:359-364 fails if an edited route falls back, loses its edit marker, or omits the pace hold reason.

findings.text: blocking: Queued admission forces route='deterministic' while passing picker_selection, but plan_dispatch applies the picked model only for route='picker' (dispatch_plan.py:565-595). A queued backend with multiple model choices launches its default model instead of the selected one; tests/test_route_before_queue.py:98-100 chooses beta's existing default and lines 255-259 assert only the backend, so the gate stays green.
